scientific_decisions.source_name: Automatically map Andropogon ischaemum var. barbinodis to modern Bothriochloa ischaemum
scientific_decisions.action: Reject: Kew explicitly places the historical variety under B. barbinodis, not the introduced KR bluestem.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Promote Dichanthium barbinode (Lag.) D.L.Fu to a separate accepted species or conflate with Dichanthium annulatum
scientific_decisions.action: Reject: 2024 name is a synonym of B. barbinodis; D. annulatum is a distinct accepted species.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Promote named B. barbinodis varieties palmeri, perforata, schlumbergeri to three independently accepted species
scientific_decisions.action: Reject under POWO/WCVP 2026; retain rank-qualified heterotypic synonym strings.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Existing learner/gallery specimens identified as B. barbinodis, KR bluestem or historical Andropogon
scientific_decisions.action: Names and synonymy cannot authenticate existing JPEGs, herbarium determinations, or native-versus-introduced field IDs; no photo labels or arrows modified.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Putative B. barbinodis × B. ischaemum or other hybrid/introgressed individual
scientific_decisions.action: No individual hybrid identification is supported here; cytogenetic variation in Bothriochloa and published introgression in other species pairs are not proof of this cross.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical Andropogon ischaemum without author, rank, locality, or voucher
scientific_decisions.action: Cannot safely assign unranked historical record to modern B. ischaemum or to historical var. barbinodis; require source text and specimen.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical Andropogon saccharoides sensu lato lacking rank/author and voucher
scientific_decisions.action: Do not infer B. barbinodis merely from saccharoides epithet; author-qualified var. barbinodis is the verified synonym.

critical_caution: The historical Andropogon ischaemum var. barbinodis is HOMOTYPIC with native Bothriochloa barbinodis, not introduced Bothriochloa ischaemum. Dichanthium barbinode (2024) is also B. barbinodis, NOT Dichanthium annulatum. Do not infer specimen ID from names.
